title: Refine self-improvement review guidance
summary: BCQuality guidance refined to reduce false positives in event handling, UI testing, performance analysis, and label scope rules by narrowing criteria to match documented platform behavior and actual code semantics.
key_points: IsHandled reset rules refined to consider loop-carried state and values that can actually become true
Local Label scope removed as a correctness rule since labels are supported in extension translation
UI handler tests allowed to use semantic capture/reset/assert patterns with queues reserved for interaction contracts
Performance guidance for ModifyAll and DeleteAll aligned with documented fallback conditions
Persisted checkpoint and bounded retrieval requirements clarified as separate concerns
quote: narrow `IsHandled` reset findings to values that can actually carry `true`, including loop-carried state
